purpose: Actionable evidence acquisition queue for AssetShakti Phase 1 real pilots. Uploads are pending verification and never satisfy critical gates automatically.

authoritativeSources.name: IBBI Corporate Process Auction Notice Register

workflow: Hash and bind to case + auction round
failClosedRules: USER_SUPPLIED_PENDING_VERIFICATION cannot satisfy a critical evidence gate.

Title, possession, valuation and bidder eligibility must not be inferred from an auction index.
Reserve price is not independent market valuation.
